name: Worldbound
description: The connected world: Greenvale, Irondeep Mountains, Whisperwood, the Ashen Desert, the Shadowlands and the Celestial Isles.

regions.name: Greenvale
regions.description: The starting valley: a riverside village, an oak forest and a small copper mine.

regions.name: Irondeep Mountains
regions.description: Dwarven halls, silver galleries and an underground lake beneath the peaks.

regions.name: Whisperwood
regions.description: An enchanted forest of ancient trees, spirit glades and mushroom caves.

regions.name: Ashen Desert
regions.description: Sand dunes over a buried kingdom: ruins, tombs and rare minerals.

regions.name: Shadowlands
regions.description: A blighted land under a dark sky: haunted fields, a black marsh and the Void Rift.

regions.name: Celestial Isles
regions.description: Floating islands above the world, reached only on a flying mount.

discoveries.name: Forgotten Forest Shrine
